# NETWORK

> Every page of the NETWORK module of the ABDM Developer Portal, fetchable as markdown.

## Pages

- [Network and discovery](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-85/docs/uhi/v1/api/network): The UHI Gateway search and on_search, the discovery pair every EUA and HSPA serves, and the network registry lookup, by service.
- [Search through the Gateway](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-85/docs/uhi/v1/api/network/endpoints/uhi-blood-bank/01-uhi-network-gateway-search): Search for services by intent
- [Search an HSPA](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-85/docs/uhi/v1/api/network/endpoints/uhi-blood-bank/02-uhi-network-search): Search for services by intent * First search coming from UHI gateway will include header(X-Gateway-Authorisation) Second search will be a peer to peer...
- [Send a catalog through the Gateway](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-85/docs/uhi/v1/api/network/endpoints/uhi-blood-bank/03-uhi-network-gateway-on-search): Accepter for all the on_search response from the HSPAs
- [Send a catalog to the EUA](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-85/docs/uhi/v1/api/network/endpoints/uhi-blood-bank/04-uhi-network-on-search): Sends catalogue.
- [Search through the Gateway](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-85/docs/uhi/v1/api/network/endpoints/uhi-jan-aushadhi-kendra-search/01-uhi-network-gateway-search): Search for services by intent
- [Search an HSPA](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-85/docs/uhi/v1/api/network/endpoints/uhi-jan-aushadhi-kendra-search/02-uhi-network-search): Search for services by intent * First search coming from UHI gateway will include header(X-Gateway-Authorisation) Second search will be a peer to peer...

- [Send a catalog to the EUA](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-85/docs/uhi/v1/api/network/endpoints/uhi-jan-aushadhi-kendra-search/04-uhi-network-on-search): Sends catalogue.
